title: In conversation with Grégoire Courtine
title_zh: 与格雷戈里·库廷的对话
abstract: As part of our special issue on neurotechnology, we spoke with Grégoire Courtine, professor at the École Polytechnique Fédérale de Lausanne, about spinal stimulation, brain–spine interfaces and the overlooked computational power of the spinal cord. He reflects on the experiment that convinced him paralysis was not necessarily irreversible and the potential of neurotechnology for fundamental neuroscience as much as clinical interventions.
abstract_zh: 作为我们神经技术专题的一部分，我们与瑞士洛桑联邦理工学院的格雷戈里·库廷教授进行了交谈，讨论了脊髓刺激、脑-脊髓接口以及脊髓被忽视的计算能力。他回顾了让他确信瘫痪不一定是不可逆的实验，以及神经技术在基础神经科学和临床干预方面的潜力。
